原题中的函数是y = sin(3x - π)。这里可以看作是y = sin(Bx - C)，其中B是3，C是π。根据公式，相位移应该是C/B，也就是π/3。不过需要确定方向，是向左还是向右移动。通常，相位移的公式是C/B，当表达式是Bx - C时，相位移是C/B向右移动。所以这里应该是向右移动π/3个单位。

The phase shift of $ y = \sin(3x - \pi) $ is calculated by rewriting the equation in the form $ y = \sin(B(x - D)) $, where $ D $ is the phase shift. Here, $ B = 3 $ and the expression inside the sine is $ 3x - \pi = 3\left(x - \frac{\pi}{3}\right) $. Thus, the phase shift is $ \frac{\pi}{3} $ units to the right.

\boxed{\dfrac{\pi}{3}}
